### Location
Which lesson or section does this suggestion apply to?

### Current State
Briefly describe how the section currently explains or presents the concept.

### Suggested Improvement
Explain what should be changed or added, and why it benefits beginner learners.

### Examples or References
Provide any relevant examples, diagrams, or official references supporting your suggestion.
